name: openai-v3-verifiable-fixture
description: Week 4 Verifier fixture: like openai_v3_project, but with a self-contained SDK shim (a `file:` dependency, not a real published package -- no network) and a real node:test suite, so depfix.verify.Verifier can install (resolves the local shim, no registry access) and run tests for real. The `openai` dependency name also makes this fixture scan-friendly: depfix.scanners.callsites only recognizes an import as SDK-bound when its require/import spec matches a provider's declared sdk_packages name.
